text:
Sam D: quick alignment check — release window tomorrow 09:00 PT. Changelog cutoff is 18:00 PT today. We need owners for: SDK packages (py/js), sample apps, docs quickstarts, and the smoke run. Who can own each?
Priya: I can own docs quickstarts. Will update the python & node snippets + a short migration note for the CLI tweak. Planning to open a docs PR by 16:30 PT. @Ling can you confirm sample apps will be ready before that? :pray:
Jared: I’ll take python packaging and the wheel+sdist publish flow. ETA for package + CI pipeline bump is 17:30 PT. Quick Q: are we removing `--auth-mode` from the CLI in this release? If so I need the exact deprecation text to include in package metadata.
Ling: taking sample apps. React example CI is currently failing because of `react-scripts` being pinned to an old version. I’ll bump to 5.1.2 and run the sample smoke locally. Opening PR now, should be green by 15:00 PT.
Sam D: thanks @Ling. If samples change APIs, Priya will need to adjust snippets. Keep changes minimal.
Priya: noted — if sample code changes surface, I’ll update docs snippets and add a short note in the changelog draft.
Elena: I can run the smoke after PRs merge. My checklist: 1) install SDKs from the staged index, 2) run quickstarts, 3) run `./scripts/smoke.sh`. Ping me in this thread when builds are available. Estimated runtime ~45m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Jared: confirming CLI change — yes, we remove `--auth-mode` and replace with `--auth-provider`; will include a fallback for one release. Deprecation blurb: "--auth-mode is deprecated; use --auth-provider instead. The old flag will be removed in next release."
Ling: PR opened: #428-react-deps-bump — CI failing only on lint, fixing now. Quick change in package.json: 
```json
{
  "dependencies": {
    "react-scripts": "5.1.2"
  }
}
```
Sam D: also need someone to cut the changelog slice and publish the draft in the repo (not the final release notes, just the chopped entries). Who can do that?
Priya: I’ll prepare the changelog draft (sections: docs, samples, SDKs, infra). Will paste the draft in the PR description by 17:00 PT.
Jared: when packaging is done I’ll create a staging index url and post it here. CI token: `staging-pypi-token-prod`. Reminder: do not publish final tags until after smoke pass.
ci-bot: Canary build 3509876621 finished — 7/8 checks passed (flake8 failed on samples).
Ling: fixing lint now; should be green in about 10 minutes.
Elena: once all PRs are merged, I’ll kick off smoke with this command: `ENV=staging ./scripts/smoke.sh --samples --sdk --docs`. Please make sure the staged wheel and npm tarball are reachable from the runner.
Sam D: small deployment plan: 1) merge sample + sdk + docs PRs, 2) packaging publish to staging, 3) Elena runs smoke, 4) if smoke green, finalize changelog and tag, 5) schedule final publish at 09:00 PT. If any step fails we fallback to delaying publish 3h or rolling back packaging.
Priya: Do we want a brief announcement in #general when the changelog draft is ready? I can post it.
Sam D: yes please — include the short migration note for `--auth-provider`.
Jared: tagging @Elena when staging index is up.
Ling: PR #428 now green and merged.
Jared: python wheels uploaded to staging index: https://staging-pypi.internal/redwood/ — posted credentials via secure channel.
Elena: running smoke now. I’ll report back with a short pass/fail and logs.
ci-bot: Smoke run started (job 8972) by Elena.
Elena: smoke passed except one minor flake in a sample test that doesn’t block functionality. Attaching last lines: `All quickstarts executed successfully. 0 critical failures.`
Sam D: awesome — thanks everyone. Priya — paste changelog draft and I’ll review quickly; if ok we finalize and tag at 09:00 PT tomorrow.
Priya: pasted changelog draft in PR description and in this thread. TL;DR: SDK: package name bump, CLI flag rename; Docs: updated quickstarts; Samples: dependency bumps and small API tweaks.
Sam D: final asks: everyone please add a one-line post-merge note in your PRs describing verification steps. We’ll reconvene here if anything blocks. :rocket:
